# Competitor Messaging Matrix

`competitor-messaging-matrix` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Strategy & Positioning
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/competitor-messaging-matrix/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** What do rival homepages all claim, what does no one claim, and can a buyer tell our headline apart from theirs?

**Inputs:** The headline, subhead, first screen of copy and calls to action from three to six competitor pages, each with the date you copied it, and optionally your own

**Output:** A claim matrix (which rivals make which of nine claim types), the crowded and open claims, the audience and category label each rival names, CTA types, category words and each rival's distinctive words, and for your own page the share of distinct words, the crowded claims you share and a verdict

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill competitor-messaging-matrix`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/competitor-messaging-matrix/resources/messaging-matrix.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/competitor-messaging-matrix/resources/messaging-matrix.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Claim types are matched by word lists, so it counts words, not meaning. 'Simple pricing' and 'simple to use' both count as ease; read the matrix against the pages before quoting it.
- It reads only the copy you paste. A paraphrased headline measures your paraphrase, and rival pages change; pages copied more than 90 days ago are flagged as stale.
- An open claim is one no rival makes, not a recommendation. It can't say whether a claim is true or whether buyers care about it.
- Distinct is not better. The distinctiveness read measures word overlap with rivals, not whether buyers want what your headline says.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns positioning checks the rival copy was pasted verbatim and dated, and checks the matrix against the pages. Before making an open claim, confirm you can prove it and that buyers care, using review-mining or interviews.
